===Objectives===
* Speak to [[Instructor Ng]].
* Complete the [[Advanced Defense Techniques]] course.
* Complete the [[Disruption]] course.
* Complete the [[Skill Chaining]] course.
* Complete the [[Snaring Course|Snaring]] course.
* See Headmaster Zhan for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 75 [[Gold]]
* [[Monastery Credit]]

==Walkthrough==
This quest requires the completion of four sub-quests given also by Instructor Ng. These sub-quests must be completed individually before the next sub-quest may be taken. The order of completion is entirely optional. The four sub-quests are listed in the objectives.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
;Headmaster Zhan
:''"You are ready to earn your Warrior Insignia? All right, then. This advanced training is designed to teach you the nuances of combat. The Warrior is masterful tactician and relies on brute strength and cunning moves to survive. He is a master Swordsman, Axe Wielder, and Hammer Master. If you are ready, speak with '''Instructor Ng''' to begin."''
{{ Offer dialog

===Reward dialogue===
;Headmaster Zhan
:''"Congratulations. You have earned your Warrior Insignia. You are now an expert Warrior. May Balthazar aid your steel, and may Dwayna protect you from harm."''
